products.name: Legendary Collection Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs plus one of four oversize reverse-holo box toppers (S1 Charizard, S2 Dark Blastoise, S3 Dark Raichu, S4 Mewtwo; the toppers are not simulated). TCGplayer lists the box (691155) with no price and no sales, so it is priced at 36 packs.

products.name: Theme Deck "Lava"
products.note: A 60-card Legendary Collection theme deck, featuring Charizard (Legendary Collection 3); metal silver Pikachu coin + Poison and generic markers. Not simulated: coin and markers. List: Bulbapedia deck page and PokeBeach's Legendary Collection theme-deck page (they differ by a card in places).
products.priceSource: No TCGplayer price for the sealed deck: the sum of its 60 cards at the site's card prices (TCGplayer market, Unlimited). A sealed deck sells for more.
